notes:
Improved
• "Cut this clip": a note like "cut this clip, it provides no value" now cuts the whole clip under your playhead. Before, Solis looked for a spoken line there and gave up when there wasn't one. A note a
• No more risers into nothing. A riser plays only when its hit actually lands; a riser whose hit didn't make it is removed. A line that only sets something up no longer gets a riser on its own.
• No more random vine booms. The vine boom (and files like "bass drop + vine boom") is kept for meme moments. It's never used as a "big moment" hit, an intro zoom hit, or a pop-up's pop.
• A joke sound needs someone to actually laugh, and a shock sound needs a real surprised face or voice. Solis AI's guess alone isn't enough.
• Every pop-up gets the same clean pop, and it can repeat after 4 seconds.
• A new track comes in in the pause before the line, never as someone starts talking. The old track fades out under it while the new one fades in.
• Music that stops fades out over a second, and music that comes back fades in. A deliberate music cut (on a fail or a shock) stays a hard cut.
